user.title: OnStar China
user.description:
Obtain a one-time login from the OnStar WeChat mini-program.

1. Capture the mini-program login with Reqable/Charles
2. Run `extract_token.py your.har` to get the fields below

- User ID: idpUserId (e.g. LADPA017243106)
- perm_token: from the login response
- VIN: 17 chars

reauth_confirm.title: OnStar login expired
reauth_confirm.description: The perm_token for {vin} is no longer valid. Log in again in the WeChat mini-program, capture it, extract a new perm_token with extract_token.py, and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired perm_token / user ID
